name: drone-training-simulator
description: Keyboard-controlled drone flight & aerial capture trainer

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build:deploy: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm run build
